text:
if you're reading translations from Greek or Roman antiquity (ie Seneca/Cicero), below is the tone u want...a bad translation can ruin the writing entirely, I've wasted $$ on flowery dogshit from amazon.

excerpt here is from Plutarch's "Moralia" -- note how laughably blunt the story and moral lesson are, plus odd terms like "Kicker," as indicators that the translator took no liberties and maintained the fidelity of the original writing

source for Plutarch: https://t.co/Ak46l3Jblq

and for Seneca's letters, this is perfect as well: https://t.co/qo1FmIsAzl
